article: Run TinyLLaMA from C++ using llama.cpp
scope: Compared the full Japanese article and all twelve translations, model acquisition, build steps, C++ APIs and CMake target against current official sources, and reviewed model size and performance claims.
findings: Removed obsolete Transformers conversion commands and stale llama.cpp C API calls.
Replaced them with the current GGUF workflow and official C++17 llama-simple example/CMake target.
Corrected the quantized file size to approximately 669 MB and qualified the model-card CPU RAM estimate.
Removed unsupported model-capability claims and added output-validation guidance.
Removed duplicate date metadata; retained original publication date and recorded lastmod.
